Lore:
^You receive an orb as a reward.

^And some money, of course.

^The orb is beautiful, smooth, luminous, almost warm in your hands.

^You stare at it for a moment, drawn in by its strange glow.

^Then, suddenly, vague shapes begin to form within it.

^Shadows. Figures.

^They move in unnatural ways, restless, haunting.

^You sense they torment those around them.

^Then, just as quickly, they vanish.

^Startled, you lift the orb again, holding it in front of your eyes.

^And there they are.

^Clearer this time.

^You're stunned, maybe even afraid... but something about them fascinates you.

^You can’t look away.

^You want to see them better.

^Understand what they are.

^What they want.

^Why they’re here.



^Congratulations, you've unlocked the possibu=ility to unreveal the monsters, spirits thats torments people.

^Press A to unreveal monster around you.

^Good Luck.
